nodes.description: Address state variable holding the throttle controller (owner), set in the constructor from msg.sender and used in the onlyThrottleController authorization check.
State variable holding the external StarBoundInterface instance at 0x801EA8C463a776E85344C565e355137b5c3324CD, used to burn tokens.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender to throttleController, establishing the privileged account.
Public function guarded by onlyThrottleController that burns the caller-supplied amount of StarBound tokens via external call.
Public pure function returning a descriptive string message; contains no state interaction.
Modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == throttleController) on any function it is applied to.
msg.sender at construction time, used to initialize the throttleController state variable.
msg.sender evaluated in the onlyThrottleController require check, compared against the stored throttleController address.
External call StarBound.burn(amount) to an untrusted external contract; executed before any state updates, allowing potential reentrancy or arbitrary external behavior.
Caller-supplied uint amount parameter of engageIonThrusters forwarded to the external burn call.

edges.reason: msg.sender captured in the constructor flows into the throttleController state variable, establishing the privileged owner.
msg.sender is consumed by the require check inside the onlyThrottleController modifier.
Stored throttleController is read and compared against msg.sender during the authorization check.
The require(msg.sender == throttleController) check conditionally gates execution of the privileged StarBound.burn external call.
The onlyThrottleController modifier wraps and controls entry into engageIonThrusters.
The modifier's authorization gate controls whether the external burn operation can be reached.
engageIonThrusters directly invokes the external StarBound.burn(amount) call.
The amount parameter is forwarded unchanged into the external burn call, making the burn value caller-controlled.
The StarBound interface state variable is dereferenced to perform the external burn call.
The external call to StarBound.burn hands control to an untrusted contract that may reenter engageIonThrusters or other privileged functions before the burn completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is a non-core node whose only role is to be passed directly as the argument of the external StarBound.burn unsafe operation, so it can be merged into that unsafe_operation node.
